title: [Main]"Use GLN in Electronic Documents" on the Company Information is not respected when importing E-Docs from Inbound E-Documents page using the Import XML action.
summary: Fixed an issue where the GLN setting on Company Information was ignored when importing electronic documents via the Import XML action from the Inbound E-Documents page.
key_points: GLN (Global Location Number) setting was not being respected during XML import
The issue occurred specifically when using the Import XML action on Inbound E-Documents page
Fix ensures Company Information settings are properly applied during e-document imports
Changes made to the E-Document Import Helper codeunit
Test coverage added to verify the fix
